pages.title: Chronosteel Singularity
pages.text: Chronosteel compressed into one point, its time-hardened structure collapsed together. Time behaves oddly around it, ticking slightly faster or slower depending on how you hold it. It is cool and dense and smells faintly of rust.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Chronosteel is steel tempered in time. I compressed enough of it in the Singularity Compactor that its timelines merged into a single point.
